title: Plumber, Solar Manufacturing
description:

This role offers the opportunity to work in a fast-paced environment focused on advancing energy sustainability. * Ability to produce parts lists and work plans based on drawings or field observations
* Thoroughly evaluate job hazards and complete pre-work task planning
* Strong initiative and the ability to work independently and effectively with others
* Willingness to travel to other projects as needed
